about: Gate policy for hook R8 (autopilot-poc-plan.md §7). A question is matched by fragments of the skill's own wording, never by a model. `park` rows are checked first. An `answer` row applies only when its role runs the session, its extra requirement holds (`epicId`: the question names the queued epic; `anchorTor`: the TOR it names is one of the epic's anchors), and its answer is among the options actually offered. Anything else parks.
